title: 农场里的新同学
selection: One SystemRandom draw of 10 non-basic KET words; order frozen before content authoring.

story.title_en: A New Friend on the Farm
story.supporting_language: Short dialogue; common A1/A2 supporting vocabulary. move away = 走开; stays = 留在; tail = 尾巴. Chinese available on each page.

scenes.title: 一次农场旅行
scenes.en: “Look at this farm online,” says Mia. “Let’s go!” Her classmate Ben has a camera. “I can be our photographer!” he says.
scenes.zh: “看网上的这个农场！”Mia 说。“我们去吧！”她的同班同学 Ben 有一台相机。“我可以当我们的摄影师！”他说。

question.answer_en: They will go to a farm.

image.alt: Mia 和穿蓝色西装的 Ben 看电脑上的农场照片，Ben 拿着相机
image.caption: 一次农场旅行

scenes.title: 靴子上的小客人
scenes.en: At the farm, Ben wears a blue suit. “Why?” asks Mia. “I want a nice photo!” A small lizard sits on his shoe. “Hello!” says Ben.
scenes.zh: 到了农场，Ben 穿着一套蓝色西装。“为什么？”Mia 问。“我想拍张好看的照片！”一只小蜥蜴停在他的鞋子上。“你好！”Ben 说。

question.answer_zh: 它在 Ben 的鞋子上。

image.alt: Mia 指着 Ben 右脚黄色雨靴上的小蜥蜴，两人惊喜地看着它
image.caption: 靴子上的小客人

scenes.title: 一位安静的小听众
scenes.en: “What’s the matter?” asks Mia. “My little friend won’t move!” Ben sings a song. The lizard stays on his shoe. Mia laughs. “It likes your song!”
scenes.zh: “怎么了？”Mia 问。“我的小朋友不肯动！”Ben 唱起一首歌。蜥蜴留在他的鞋子上。Mia 笑了：“它喜欢你的歌！”

question.answer_en: No. It stays on Ben’s shoe.
question.answer_zh: 没有。它还留在 Ben 的鞋子上。

image.caption: 一位安静的小听众

scenes.title: 四只脚的新同学
scenes.en: Afterwards, they send a card to their class. Mia puts a stamp on it. Ben writes, “Our new classmate has four feet!” The photo shows the lizard.
scenes.zh: 后来，他们给全班寄了一张卡片。Mia 在上面贴了一张邮票。Ben 写道：“我们的新同学有四只脚！”照片里就是那只蜥蜴。

image.alt: Mia 在明信片右上角贴邮票，Ben 指着旁边蜥蜴停在黄色雨靴上的照片
image.caption: 四只脚的新同学
